jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Ritual 

Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.

About the role

As a Frontend Engineer at Ritual, you'll build sophisticated interfaces that enable developers to interact with our AI and blockchain infrastructure, as well as rapidly build prototypes built on top of Ritual Chain. You'll create intuitive dashboards and monitoring tools that make complex distributed systems accessible and manageable, from tracking cross-chain transactions to monitoring AI compute nodes, and much more.

  • Design and implement transaction monitoring interfaces that visualize the complete lifecycle across Ritual's infrastructure, including broker status, node operations, and cross-chain interactions
  • Build and maintain dashboard interfaces for things like node deployment, monitoring, and management across cloud providers
  • Develop web applications that enable users to provision and manage customized node infrastructure through intuitive interfaces
  • Create responsive dashboards for real-time monitoring of distributed compute resources and container management
  • Design and implement DeFi-style interfaces for protocol interactions, similar to DEX and vault management experiences
  • Work closely with product, design, and backend teams to create seamless user experiences
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
  • Writing efficient, high-quality code that maintains our high standards for user experience

About you

  • Robust fundamental understanding of HTML/CSS, TypeScript, and React
  • Strong experience productionizing user interfaces for decentralized applications that interact directly with various EVM-based blockchains
  • Strong experience with popular Web3 wallet integration libraries (wagmi, ethers, etc.) and blockchain interaction patterns
  • Proven full-stack experience, with the ability to diagnose and resolve end-to-end issues independently from frontend to backend, including familiarity with API design and server-side architectures
  • Proficiency with Linux and command-line environments for development and debugging
  • Experience building responsive monitoring dashboards and data visualization interfaces
  • Expertise in state management patterns and real-time data handling
  • Strong understanding of cross-chain transaction flows and blockchain infrastructure
  • Experience with modern frontend build tools and deployment pipelines
  • Ability to act quickly under high pressure scenarios and context switch at a high frequency
  • A high level of end-to-end ownership and self-direction, with excellent communication skills
  • Hungry, high-energy and ability to work within and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Nice to have

  • Proven track record developing multi-platform applications (web, desktop, mobile)
  • Experience building interfaces for distributed systems or node management
  • Background with AI/ML infrastructure monitoring and management
  • Familiarity with container orchestration and cloud provider interfaces
  • Experience with Electron or similar desktop application frameworks
  • Knowledge of GraphQL and real-time data subscriptions
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (80% backend)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Postscript is the AI-powered, all-in-one retention platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands, including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

Our mission is to maximize the lifetime value of every shopper. We built the best-in-class SMS platform, expanded into email, and launched revenue-driving AI products you won’t find anywhere else. Now we’re building the most AI-forward team in ecommerce, and we’re just getting started.

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator. Fully remote since 2018.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Postscript, you'll be a high-ownership contributor to one of our core product or platform teams — owning meaningful systems end-to-end, driving technical quality, and helping shape how we build across the organization. Our engineering teams operate at the intersection of scale and product velocity, which means you'll be working on distributed systems that matter to the business while also influencing the technical standards that allow Postscript to grow sustainably.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well — without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day-to-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it.

This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.

Primary Duties

  • Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team — becoming the go-to technical expert for what you own
  • Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
  • Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use
  • Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction — improving long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
  • Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work
  • Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows — not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams — communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
  • Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
  • Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

What We'll Love About You

  • 6+ years of experience building large-scale backend systems and APIs
  • You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
  • Tech stack: Python, Go, React, and TypeScript; experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Datadog, and relational/
